title: List of Mario Kart World missions
html:
This article needs Mario Kart improvement. Specifically:

  • Add descriptions for every mission.
    • Data can be modified by editing the file at Module:MKWorld missions/data.json.
Requested improvements must be clear, pertinent, and well-formed. Please refrain from adding bullet points such as "Add more information" or "Write the rest of the article".

It has been requested that more images be uploaded for this article. Remove this notice only after the additional images have been added. Specifics: Images for all the missions

Mario Kart World features 394 missions for players to complete in the game's Free Roam mode. Missions may be activated via P Switches, placing the player into brief, timed challenges with objectives such as collecting blue coins, finishing a few laps of a short race, and traversing the area to reach a goal ring. Each mission completed unlocks a sticker. Below is a list of missions found in the game. All separation between biomes, as well as the names of the biomes themselves, is conjectural.

Mesa biome

This biome contains Mario Bros. Circuit, Whistlestop Summit, and Wario Stadium.

Image In-game text Location Time limit (seconds) Description Sticker
Aim for the Goal Pole atop the massive mushroom! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must use Glide Ramps and Rings to glide over the mushroom-like rock formation, touching the Goal Pole at the top.
Bring an appetite and race to the goal! Mario Bros. Circuit 10.00 The player must use Dash Food at various spots along a course to reach the goal in time.
Charge through the defensive line! Mario Bros. Circuit 25.00 The player must drive through a team of Chargin' Chucks, including Clappin' Chucks, Passin' Chucks and Splittin' Chucks.
Collect blue coins spanning the bridge! Mario Bros. Circuit 12.00 The player must collect eight blue coins by driving along a Dash Panel ramp and rail riding along the right side of the bridge, with the last blue coin right after it. The fifth blue coin requires a trick to reach.
Collect coins while pulling off high-flying stunts! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must collect blue coins by driving over rooftops with the help of Dash Panel ramps.
Do tricks off the cacti for extra height! Mario Bros. Circuit 7.00 The player must trick off ramps to trick off cacti and reach airborne rings in time, including the goal ring. There are two rings that each add 2 seconds to the timer.
Drop in on the racers atop the rocks! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must use a Glide Ramp to launch to the top of a butte to find other participating racers and scattered Item Boxes. After navigating around this butte, the player must pass three Clappin' Chucks to reach another Glide Ramp and glide around a "Home of the Rainbow Fragment" sign. A third Glide Ramp leads to a section with a Goomba Tower and two elevated Passin' Chucks. The goal ring is found on a second butte and can be reached by bouncing off two consecutive Bouncy Clouds.
Evade the armadillos on your way to the goal! Mario Bros. Circuit 10.00 The player must reach the goal ring by avoiding armadillos with ramps and rocks to trick on. There are two rings that each add 5 seconds to the timer.
Fly over to Yoshi's for a quick bite! Mario Bros. Circuit 11.00 The player must drive towards a ramp with a Dash Panel that takes the player to a Glide Ramp, sending them flying to reach the goal ring surrounding a circular Yoshi's sign. There are three rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer.
Follow that helicopter! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must follow a helicopter through various roads until reaching the starting line of Crown City. Each ring adds ten or fifteen seconds to the timer.
Gather blue coins and dodge the Goombas! Mario Bros. Circuit 25.00 The player must collect all blue coins around an area while avoiding various Goombas.
Hop along the blocky shortcut to Wario Stadium! Mario Bros. Circuit 18.00 The player must use a Pipe Cannon in between two triangular Goomba Towers to reach a path of Brick Blocks and ? Blocks that the player and trick on to jump over gaps; Koopa Paratroopas fly around this area. This path ends with a Dash Panel ramp that leads the player to the Goal Pole.
Mush-zoom to the goal and don't sink! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must drive through Item Boxes as they reach the edges of the terrain; these Item Boxes give the player Dash Mushrooms that allow the player to drive through a large portion of Choco Mountain's chocolate without sinking to reach the goal ring.
Race over ramps and beams to reach the goal! Mario Bros. Circuit 8.00 The player must drive towards two Dash Panel ramps leading to a higher portion of the terrain, bounce off a Trampoline to reach a black frame with a Star Ring and a ramp which takes the player to a Glide Ramp after a left turn right before the goal ring. There are four rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer.
Race through the stands to the goal! Mario Bros. Circuit 12.00 The player must rail ride along three rails along a large curved bleacher; there are coins to indicate where to trick. The end of the bleacher leads to some large containers that the player drives over to reach the goal ring.
Rail ride to gather the burger's blue coins! Mario Bros. Circuit 20.00 The player must collect eight blue coins on a capsule-shaped grindrail. A trick from another grindrail is required to reach the rail containing the blue coins.
Ramp up over the cliff edge to the goal! Mario Bros. Circuit 16.00 The player must use a series of Dash Panels on ramps and rings to navigate towards and eventually up the side of a cliff, before gliding into the goal ring.
Rely on tornado tailwinds to reach the Goal Pole! Mario Bros. Circuit 25.00 The player must use tornados to gain height and glide to the Goal Pole
Roar down the road in an explosive action scene! Mario Bros. Circuit 15.00 The player must drive a ride truck through several cars, buses and trucks.
Soar through the air and through the bridge! Mario Bros. Circuit 15.00 The player must drive towards a Dash Panel ramp leading to three Star Rings that allow the player to glide towards the goal ring on the other side of the bridge.
Soar up to the train station's Goal Pole! Mario Bros. Circuit 25.00 The player must use two Glide Ramps to reach a Goal Pole located on the roof of a train station. There are five rings that each add 2 seconds to the timer.
Take the offroad shortcut to Mario Bros. Circuit! Mario Bros. Circuit 22.00 The player must use a series of Star Rings to boost through offroad, then use a Dash Panel on a ramp to launch into the goal ring.
Use items to blitz across the desert sands! Mario Bros. Circuit 15.00 The player must drive offroad with a row of Double Item Boxes at the start and some Item Boxes further along to help the player reach the goal ring, which is located on a rock within the desert. Item Boxes always give the player a Dash Mushroom or a Super Star. There are some rocks for performing tricks, as well as some Dry Bones and sand-dwelling Charvaarghs as obstacles. There are three rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer.
Inspect the railroad yard for blue coins! Whistlestop Summit 12.00 The player must collect eight blue coins by reaching the top of two trains with a ramp at the back of each one. Tricking off the second ramp is required to collect the seventh blue coin.
Join in on a daredevil canyon loop! Whistlestop Summit 27.00 The player must drive three laps around a race which goes up a road, down a cliff and down a river before going back up the road again. Treaded Grrrols appear as obstacles, each blue ring adds 6 seconds to the timer, and the finish line adds 10.
Join the spontaneous race in the canyon! Whistlestop Summit 20.00
Launch from pipe to pipe up the plateaus! Whistlestop Summit 25.00
Make a path through the back-road route! Whistlestop Summit 13.00 The player must drive through the wilderness, avoiding Goombas and Goomba Towers, then use a Super Horn to break through the last group of Goomba Towers before reaching the goal. Each ring adds three seconds to the timer.
Perform stunt after stunt across the bridge! Whistlestop Summit 9.00
Prove yourself in a SPECIAL test of skill #6! Whistlestop Summit 4.00
Race to the top of Whistlestop Summit! Whistlestop Summit 12.00 The player must travel to the top of the location by using a Glide Ramp and making a few U-turns to reach a second Glide Ramp towards the goal ring.
Race upstream through the river valley! Whistlestop Summit 17.00
Ramp up and over the suspension bridge! Whistlestop Summit 14.00
Show off your wall-riding skills! Whistlestop Summit 8.00 The player must jump onto the wall and drive on it to reach the goal ring. A ring that adds 5 seconds to the timer can be driven through as soon as the player jumps on the wall.
Show the train how fast you can go! Whistlestop Summit 14.00 The player must pass through a set of Item Boxes containing a Golden Dash Mushroom, followed by using it to pass the train and off a ramp to reach the train track where the goal ring is located.
Soar from plateau to plateau using steel ramps! Whistlestop Summit 20.00
Turn up the tricks to collect all the blue coins! Whistlestop Summit 9.00 The player must collect eight blue coins by tricking on the train track rails in quick succession.
Borrow the truck and smash through! Wario Stadium 20.00 The player must use a Ride truck to drive through several obstacles and reach the goal. Along the way, the obstacles encountered are crates, oil drums, buses, trucks, Treaded Grrrols and unchained Chain Chomps. The mission ends at Toad's Factory.
Cross the beams of the busted bridge! Wario Stadium 10.00 The player must drive on top of the beams on a collapsed bridge, tricking off of them to reach the goal.
Drive through the Treaded Grrrol crossing! Wario Stadium 10.00 The player must reach the goal ring at the end of a long stretch of road while avoiding a large number of Treaded Grrrols along the way.
Follow the rings along the rooftops! Wario Stadium 12.00 The player must use various rings along a route to reach the goal in time. Passing each ring adds 3 seconds to the timer.
Gather blue coins from the rooftops! Wario Stadium 20.00 The player must collect 10 blue coins within the time limit.
Overtake the train crossing the truss bridge! Wario Stadium 24.00 The player must rail ride on train tracks to overtake a train crossing a bridge.
Race through a treacherous tire trial! Wario Stadium 18.00 The player must race through an obstacle course featuring various tire stacks and Treaded Grrrols.
Ramp through rings and over flames! Wario Stadium 6.00 The player must use ramps with Dash Panels to jump through three rings. Each ring adds four extra seconds to the timer.
Show off serious tightrope-riding skills! Wario Stadium 10.00 The player must rail ride on power lines held up by large pylons, jumping from line to line to cross blue rings and avoid Fuzzies. Each blue ring adds 5 seconds to the timer.
Show Shy Guys how to race downriver! Wario Stadium 15.00 The player must complete a race going down a river. Each ring addes five seconds to the timer.
Survive the spicy Fire Piranha Plant gauntlet! Wario Stadium 10.00 The player must complete a short route avoiding fireballs shot by Fire Piranha Plants.
Tackle an endurance challenge in the wasteland! Wario Stadium 20.00 The player must drive through a long, two-lap course. Passing through each gate adds six seconds to the timer.
Thread the gaps in the steel supports! Wario Stadium 10.00

Southern sea and coast

This biome contains Crown City, DK Spaceport, and Koopa Troopa Beach.

Image In-game text Location Time limit (seconds) Description Sticker
Bounce, bounce, bounce to a grand vantage point! Crown City 15.00 The player must use a trampoline flower and cloud platforms to bounce and reach the goal on top of a large hill.
Collect blue coins in a tricky rail-riding challenge! Crown City 16.00 The player must collect blue coins on by rail riding on the support cables of the Crown Bridge.
Dash through traffic on the covered roads! Crown City 6.00
Dodge Bowser's minions on your way to the goal! Crown City 30.00
Drift through the parking garage like a legend! Crown City 10.00 The player must spiral down the parking lot to reach the goal, with a few cars in the way. The bottom floor has a ramp that takes the player along the roofs of small buildings to the goal ring. There are ten rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer.
Figure out a figure eight to grab the blue coins! Crown City 20.00 The player must collect eight blue coins, with each half surrounding one of the two areas with four Spikes that throw Spike Balls to attack the player.
Gather blue coins on the park's twists and turns! Crown City 40.00 The player must collect eight blue coins in the park with several Toads and Yoshis cheering on them, which can act as additional obstacles as they make the player bounce and possibly miss a blue coin.
Grab that parking spot! Fast! Crown City 7.00
Hit the beach! Crown City 15.00
Pick up blue coins...and maybe a donut at the end? Crown City 18.00
Race through dinosaur-filled streets! Crown City 6.00 The player must drive through the streets of Crown City while avoiding T. rexes and Pterosaurs, and using Brachiosauruses and Triceratops as platforms.
Ride the urban railings to collect blue coins! Crown City 20.00
Take a parkour tour of Crown City! Crown City 6.50 The player must drive through various rooftops in Crown City using wall rides and rail rides to reach the goal. Each ring adds three seconds to the timer.
Take a somewhat-leisurely path to the goal! Crown City 12.00
Take the river route to the city! Crown City 15.00
Test your endurance in a race all over town! Crown City 15.00 The player must race across several areas of Crown City with other racers participating and Item Boxes scattered throughout. There are twenty-four rings that each add 8 seconds to the timer.
"Vined" a way to the trophy of trophies! Crown City 20.00
Board your chartered flight to the city! DK Spaceport 12.00 The player must carefully balance their vehicle on top of seaplanes as they take off. During the flight, the player must cross from plane to plane in order to reach Crown City. The mission ends on a rooftop overlooking the course.
Borrow some upgrades to reach the goal! DK Spaceport 40.00 The player must drive a ride truck through various obstacles to go from DK Spaceport to Crown City. Obstacles include Passin' and Clappin' Chucks, Bob-omb Cars, pickup trucks, truck trailers and oil drums. At the end, a ride heli is used to cross the bay.
Check out the secret back-road barrel shortcut! DK Spaceport 20.00 The player must use several Barrel Cannons to launch themselves from the start to a Goal Pole under DK Spaceport.
Honk if you like to gather blue coins! DK Spaceport 25.00 The player must collect eight blue coins while using Super Horns to defeat Goombas, Stingbies, and Chargin' Chucks blocking the path.
Practice precision driving in pursuit of blue coins! DK Spaceport 20.00
Race back through DK Spaceport! DK Spaceport 80.00 The player must race from the top of DK Spaceport all the way to the bottom. Obstacles which are normally present during races on the course appear here, such as barrels, oil drums, Fire Snakes and Robo DK at the end. Fuzzies and Sidesteppers also appear as obstacles.
Race to get ahead of the explosives! DK Spaceport 14.00 The player must use a Golden Dash Mushroom to race ahead of a Bob-omb Car before it blows up the Dash panel ramp truck which leads to the Goal Pole. Two other Bob-omb Cars blow up trucks blocking the way.
Remember the classic DONKEY KONG! DK Spaceport 10.00 The player must bounce on Trampolines to climb up a set of stairs based on the Donkey Kong game. The ending features two Barrel Cannons that help the player reach the goal ring. There are seven rings that each add 4 seconds to the timer.
Ride the pipes to get the launchpad's blue coins! DK Spaceport 20.00
Trick off vehicles on the way to the spaceport! DK Spaceport 10.00
Bounce your way to Koopa Troopa Beach! Koopa Troopa Beach 20.00 The player must reach Koopa Troopa Beach first by gliding, then by using Jellybeams to bounce and reach various blue rings and the goal ring.
Brave sand and surf in a beachside race! Koopa Troopa Beach 20.00 The player must race three laps alongside computer-controlled drivers around the pier leading from Koopa Troopa Beach to Dino Dino Jungle
Collect blue coins on the floating obstacle course! Koopa Troopa Beach 30.00 The player must collect blue coins around a pill-shaped course with various buoys acting as obstacles.
Navigate the schools of fish to reach the goal! Koopa Troopa Beach 15.00 The player must reach the goal ring by crossing the ocean between a pier and an island. They must first use a Glide Ramp to glide into the first blue ring, which adds ten seconds to the timer. Afterwards, they must pass several Cheep Cheeps and launch off a ramp with Dash Panels into the second blue ring, which adds five seconds to the timer. Finally, they must evade Porcupuffers before reaching the goal ring on the island's beach.
Race around a tribute to Koopa Beach 1! Koopa Troopa Beach 15.00 The player must complete three laps around Koopa Beach 1 in the time limit, with other racers participating, Item Boxes scattered throughout, and Cheep Cheeps as obstacles. Each lap has six rings that each add 2 seconds to the timer, while the one marking the end of the lap adds 5 seconds.
Rail ride the ropes to the top! Koopa Troopa Beach 8.00 The player must rail ride on the rope grindrails while performing a wall ride at the start and performing jump at the end of the second rope. The third rope leads to a gliding section that leads the player to the goal ring. There are three rings that each add 5 seconds to the timer.
Receive a whale of a welcome to Peach Stadium! Koopa Troopa Beach 12.00 The player must use a Glide Ramp to glide to the right off of the Crown Bridge and pass through a blue ring that adds ten seconds to the timer. Next, they must use the spouting of a whale to rise into another blue ring which adds fifteen seconds to the timer. Then, they must pass over waves formed by the leaping of another whale to reach a blue ring that adds six seconds to the timer before reaching the goal ring.
Take a dangerous voyage to the distant city! Koopa Troopa Beach 20.00 The player must drive across the water to Crown City while avoiding Porcupuffers, Ty-foos, Cheep Cheeps, and Sidesteppers. Two rings that each add 10 seconds to the timer can be driven through. A Jellybeam can also be driven on to jump over a row of Porcupuffers.
Trick your heart out in this challenging trial! Koopa Troopa Beach 9.00 The player must use rings, grindrails and a quarter pipe in order to drive across a section of the bridge's supports and reach the goal.

Desert biome

This biome contains Desert Hills, Shy Guy Bazaar, and Chain Chomp Desert.

Image In-game text Location Time limit (seconds) Description Sticker
Avoid the Fire Snakes in the tunnel! Desert Hills 15.00 The player must navigate a wavy road while avoiding Fire Snakes. The goal ring is located after a Glide Ramp, allowing the player to glide to it. There are six rings that each add 2 seconds to the timer.
Chase each Tokotoko to the next! Desert Hills 25.00 The player must race towards the goal alongside several Tokotokos.
Dodge Tokotokos on the way uphill! Desert Hills 20.00 The player must drive along the first few turns of Desert Hills to reach the goal ring at the edge of a hill while avoiding Tokotokos.
Follow the rope for the ruin's blue coins! Desert Hills 20.00 The player must collect eight blue coins by rail riding on rope grindrails, as well as tricking to reach the remaining three coins, the latter of which is on a platform to the right.
Launch from pipe to pipe to reach the goal! Desert Hills 30.00
Pull off tricky jumps from column to column! Desert Hills 5.00 The player must trick near three stone columns to reach the goal ring. After the second column, there is a ring which adds 3 seconds to the timer.
Sprint to the goal through a sea of sand! Desert Hills 35.00
Tackle a sandy test of endurance! Desert Hills 20.00
Take to the skies to escape the desert! Desert Hills 17.00
Traverse desert skies and grassy hills to the goal! Desert Hills 5.00 The player must drive along a left turn to reach a Glide Ramp, then gliding towards a grassy area and using the slopes to reach the top of the area where the goal ring resides. There are ten rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer.
Zip forward and spring up to the Goal Pole! Desert Hills 10.00
Break through the Hammer Bros. blockade! Shy Guy Bazaar 15.00 The player must reach the goal ring by consuming a Dash Food bag to gain speed and breaking through Brick Blocks while avoiding hammers thrown by Hammer Bros. positioned above.
Bust a path through the maze of blocks! Shy Guy Bazaar 45.00 The player must break through several Brick Blocks in a maze made out of Empty Blocks in order to reach the goal. Alternatively, a Feather can be brought into the mission to drive over the blocks and still reach the goal.
Collect blue coins in the dried-up oasis! Shy Guy Bazaar 40.00 The player must collect 8 blue coins in a dried-up oasis while avoiding Charvaarghs.
Cool off at the oasis while grabbing blue coins! Shy Guy Bazaar 40.00 The player must reach the goal ring by collecting eight blue coins while descending from the sand into the river. A blue coin is positioned at the edge of the highest sand level. The player continues downward, eventually reaching the river, where Innertube Goombas attempt to attack. The remaining seven blue coins are located within the water.
Cruise along the curving route to reach the goal! Shy Guy Bazaar 30.00 The player must drive through the looping metal platform that takes players from the desert up to Airship Fortress, while avoiding several Bullies on the way.
Dash wisely to reach the goal in time! Shy Guy Bazaar 30.00
Dash, dash, dash to the goal! Shy Guy Bazaar 40.00
Dodge the Chain Chomps as you ascend! Shy Guy Bazaar 30.00
Harness 18 wheels of power to reach the goal! Shy Guy Bazaar 20.00 The player must reach the goal ring by hijacking the cargo truck and plowing through Pokeys and Tokotokos obstructing the path.
Hitch a ride to collect the airborne blue coins! Shy Guy Bazaar 50.00
Overtake Shy Guys in an upriver race! Shy Guy Bazaar 50.00 The player must reach the goal ring by racing against Shy Guys piloting jet skis. After starting on sand, the player enters the river and collects a single Item Box containing either a Dash Mushroom, Banana, or Red Shell. Further ahead, the player obtains a Double Item Box located beneath a stone bridge, which exclusively grants Triple Mushrooms. Rocks in the off-road section provide opportunities for tricks. The player must defeat all Shy Guys to complete the mission.
Pass by plenty of Pokeys partying on the path! Shy Guy Bazaar 16.00
Race down the river and escape to the sea! Shy Guy Bazaar 15.00 The player must reach the goal ring by hijacking a boat and plowing through Innertube Goombas while utilizing a speed boost. There are five rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer when driven through, with a large group of Innertube Goombas appearing near the end.
Race through a storm of rain and coins! Shy Guy Bazaar 8.00 The player must avoid the Coin Coffers while it is raining coins. There are four rings when the player tricks on the ramps, each adding five seconds to the timer when driven through. The player can also trick on the rocks. The end features a trickable trampoline and a Goal Pole.
Ride along the outer wall to sneak in! Shy Guy Bazaar 12.00
Salvage the scattered blue coins! Shy Guy Bazaar 50.00
Scope out the bazaar and scoop up blue coins! Shy Guy Bazaar 40.00
Slip past the Batadon blockades! Shy Guy Bazaar 20.00 The player must reach the goal ring by avoiding all the Batadons.
Tackle Shy Guy Challenge #1! Shy Guy Bazaar 17.00
Tackle Shy Guy Challenge #2! Shy Guy Bazaar 20.00
Tackle Shy Guy Challenge #3! Shy Guy Bazaar 7.00
Take a long-distance rail ride to the goal! Shy Guy Bazaar 10.00 The player must reach the goal ring at the end of the tunnel by grinding on the rail and avoiding the Fuzzies and Goombas by either getting items to hit them or jumping over them. The first item set gives the player Triple Green Shells, the second a Coin Shell, and the final a Super Star. There is a train in the tunnel that requires the player to use the Super Star to not get hit. There are also 11 rings that add five seconds to the timer when driven through.
Take a tricky tour through Shy Guy Bazaar! Shy Guy Bazaar 5.00
Travel across the bridge, tricking all the way! Shy Guy Bazaar 10.00
Use the ancient shipwrecks to get a boost! Shy Guy Bazaar 35.00
Weave around the treacherous tornadoes! Shy Guy Bazaar 20.00
Grab the blue coins and don't sink! Chain Chomp Desert 60.00
Rescue blue coins from the sands! Chain Chomp Desert 60.00 The player must collect 8 blue coins in Chain Chomp Desert, while Charvaarghs leap around the arena every few seconds.

Volcanic biome

This biome contains Airship Fortress, Dry Bones Burnout, Bowser's Castle, and Big Donut.

Image In-game text Location Time limit (seconds) Description Sticker
Drift to the top of the twisting tower! Airship Fortress 14.00 The player must drift up to the top of the tower in Airship Fortress. Each ring adds two seconds to the timer.
Make a connecting flight to the Airship Fortress! Airship Fortress 20.00
Scoop up blue coins while riding the rails! Airship Fortress 20.00
Show your stuff in this Airship Fortress time trial! Airship Fortress 6.00
Slip by line after line of Rocky Wrenches! Airship Fortress 12.00
Take a long flight for a hole in one! Airship Fortress 20.00
Weave your way through the Whamps! Airship Fortress 20.00 The player must reach the end of a zig-zagging road while avoiding various Whamps along the way.
Balance on the tightrope to gather blue coins! Dry Bones Burnout 25.00 The player must use grindrails to collect blue coins on structures in Dry Bones Burnout
Collect blue coins in the hot springs! Dry Bones Burnout 40.00 The player must collect blue coins around the hot springs while avoiding Fish Bones.
Dodge the fireballs and collect blue coins! Dry Bones Burnout 30.00
Grab the blue coins around the spooky graveyard! Dry Bones Burnout 45.00
Ride geysers and shoot through rings to the goal! Dry Bones Burnout 10.00
Show everyone how to ride the wall! Dry Bones Burnout 10.00 The player must wall ride in order to reach a ring and glide towards the goal. Each ring adds three seconds to the timer.
Slip past shocking sumo stomps! Dry Bones Burnout 20.00
Weave through the road crowded with Dry Bones! Dry Bones Burnout 20.00
Zip by Fish Bones on the way to the hot springs! Dry Bones Burnout 25.00
Bullet Bill through the fiery barrage! Bowser's Castle 20.00 The player must use a Bullet Bill to get past a wave of several lava bombs.
Gather blue coins and watch out for Thwomps! Bowser's Castle 20.00 The player must collect eight blue coins along a straightaway with several Thwomps. The final blue coin is located in the air after a Dash Panel ramp.
Gather blue coins around the spicy food court! Bowser's Castle 20.00
Hitch a ride in the helicopter and flee a fiery fate! Bowser's Castle 10.00
Hop along the walls of Bowser's Castle! Bowser's Castle 35.00
Navigate a path of pipes and rings! Bowser's Castle 10.00 The player must reach the goal ring by wall-riding and tricking towards a Star Ring that enables them to glide over a pool of lava, where another Star Ring can be seen. There are two rings that each add 3 seconds to the timer when driven through.
Perform tricks without plunging into lava pools! Bowser's Castle 5.00
Race along a course filled with Bowser's minions! Bowser's Castle 15.00
Slide by waves of fireballs! Don't get singed! Bowser's Castle 20.00 The player must reach the goal while avoiding various Fire Bros. shooting fireballs from the top of floating blocks.
Use Mushrooms to zip up the right-hand path! Bowser's Castle 11.00
Zip up the left-hand path, Mushroom-free! Bowser's Castle 11.00
Blitz past Bullies while gathering blue coins! Big Donut 30.00 The player must collect blue coins in a circle around Big Donut while avoiding many Bullies.
Fly safely above the lake of lava! Big Donut 20.00 The player must use rings to glide to the goal, while Charvaarghs leap from the lava lake below. Two Boom Booms are found at the end protecting the goal.
Gather blue coins along a narrow road! Big Donut 35.00
Race to the top of the castle wall! Big Donut 7.00
Show the lava that you're a super star! Big Donut 15.00
Snag a couple snacks in a race around Big Donut! Big Donut 20.00 The player must race three laps around Big Donut collecting Dash Food which only contains donuts. Boom Booms and Bullies appear as obstacles, while two Charvaarghs swim in the central lava pool.
Tear up the track with trick after trick! Big Donut 8.00

Snow biome

This biome contains DK Pass, Starview Peak, and Sky-High Sundae.

Image In-game text Location Time limit (seconds) Description Sticker
C-c-c-collect the blue coins at DK Pass! DK Pass 12.00 The player must collect eight blue coins along grindrails around the final turn of DK Pass. The final two blue coins are located against a wall and can be reached with a wall ride.
Clear your path with some fireballs! DK Pass 20.00 The player must navigate a road filled with sets of Snow Pokeys and Chill Bullies. Fire Flowers are provided by Double Item Boxes, and two blue rings each add 3 seconds to the timer. A Glide Ramp leads to a final section with more sets of Snow Pokeys and a goal ring.
Collect blue coins among the Snow Pokeys! DK Pass 25.00 The player must collect eight blue coins placed in the gaps between a field of Snow Pokeys.
Crash through traffic to reach the slopes! DK Pass 8.00 The player must commandeer a ride truck while passing through blue rings and crashing through parked buses, Snowmen, and three cars driving offroad. A goal ring is found past a traffic jam consisting of various vehicles.
Drop into the Shy Guy snowboarding competition! DK Pass 12.00 The player must pass through blue rings while driving down the downhill segment of DK Pass and avoiding Snowboarding Shy Guys. A goal ring is located at the course's finish line.
Grab blue coins as snowballs descend the slopes! DK Pass 40.00 The player must collect eight blue coins scattered uphill around a ski slope while avoiding snowballs rolling down the slopes.
Hitch a ride on the train to reach the goal! DK Pass 15.00 The player must receive speed boosts from snowflake rings and rail ride along train tracks to drive up the back slope of a train to reach a floating goal ring.
Hustle up and down to gather the blue coins! DK Pass 30.00 The player must collect eight blue coins, with each pair of coins being placed at opposite sides of a wooden road. Ice Bros. on Cloud Lifts throw ice balls from above.
Join the snowballs in a race downhill! DK Pass 15.00
Power past Fuzzies while gathering blue coins! DK Pass 25.00 The player must collect eight blue coins using a rail ride on a power line, dodging Fuzzies moving along the power line, along the way.
Prove yourself in a SPECIAL test of skill #5! DK Pass 5.00 Starting from an elevated platform with a Mushroom crate, the player must drop down into the final turn of DK Pass and wall ride against hovering Arrow Signs while passing through blue rings to reach a goal ring.
Race through the empty stands to the goal!
